overview_description.description:
Intellect is a modern-day mental health company with a mission to make mental healthcare and well-being support accessible for everyone. The company has developed a simple and effective mental health journey. Utilizing both technology and human interaction to create memorable human contact.

Intellect serves over 3 million members and organizations globally through its mental health platform. Intellect was also selected as one of Google’s Best Apps of 2020. 

Intellect is backed by leading investors including Insignia Ventures Partners, Y Combinator, HOF Capital, Headline, East Ventures, MS&AD Ventures, as well as an extensive list of family offices, big tech executives & renowned angel investors.

product.name: Intellect EAP
product.description: An employee assistance program providing 24/7 mental health support, including crisis management and access to licensed professionals.

product.name: Intellect Clinics
product.description: A service offering access to licensed mental health professionals for therapy and counseling sessions, both in-person and online.

product.name: Intellect Consulting
product.description: Organizational consulting services that diagnose, design, and implement workplace wellbeing strategies linked to performance outcomes.

product.name: Mental Health First Aid™
product.description: A certification program that trains employees and leaders to recognize and respond to mental health issues in the workplace.

product.name: Self-Care App and Skill-Building Programs
product.description: A digital platform offering personalized, clinically-validated mental wellbeing programs and self-care tools accessible anytime.
